title: I Dug a Rabbit Hole
summary: I opened a space for unfiltered thoughts and unfinished ideas.
content:
Unfiltered thoughts, half-baked ideas, sometimes just muttering.
This isn't an official company channel, much less the company's official stance.
This is just the inside of my head. Fair warning: it's a mess.

Only if you want to follow me down.

- Simon
